identity.title: [v0.92][WP-22A] Repair quality-gate evidence hydration and release-credit semantics

values.summary: Initialize and bind #467, inspect the #311 quality-gate generator and v0.92 evidence surfaces, implement deterministic row hydration and validator semantics, regenerate the 33-row corrective packet, run focused positive/adversarial tests plus hygiene checks, obtain exact-head review, and publish a PR closing #467 without merging.

steps.action: Initialize and bind #467, preserving #311 history and #312 boundaries.
Implement deterministic canonical discovery, hydration, blocker taxonomy, and validator completeness/substitution guards.
Expand positive controls and adversarial tests, regenerate corrective evidence/docs, validate, review, and publish.

invariants: The denominator remains exactly 13 feature rows plus 20 critical-path rows.
Accepted rows must bind exact repository, path, PR, merge, ancestry, check, proof, claim-boundary, and terminal authority evidence.
Unaccepted rows must carry a concrete classified blocker.
Uninvestigated all-blocked output is not publishable.
risks: Existing evidence may be stale or non-ancestral and must not be converted into release credit.
Mapping incomplete evidence could accidentally become product failure language.
Broad GitHub evidence discovery could be slow or drift-prone.
Corrected documentation could overclaim v0.92 readiness.
stop_conditions: Exact accepted-row evidence cannot be bound without substitution or stale authority.
Validator cannot independently recompute the denominator and row classifications.
Fresh exact-head review finds unresolved actionable defects.
Publication would require mutating #312, rewriting #311 history, or relying on administrative closeout as a dependency.
